hypothesis: Instead of relying only on pointwise mediator prediction errors, an eight-row tokenless causal mechanism representation can learn reusable local intervention-effect invariants: its rule must predict not merely pre/post output bits but the direction of mediator changes from a witnessed actual do-action. With the identical eight public records, this contrastive do-response constraint should improve unfamiliar-family reward and exact attainable-goal recovery over the strongest fully trained pointwise grammar MAP conventional.

mechanism.model: Competing structural causal programs over the unchanged original AAI-12P public full generating grammar, decomposed into 4 causal mediator mechanisms, with explicit intervention-effect constraints on observed adjacent actual do transitions; predictors compose selected mechanisms in 4-stage DAG.
mechanism.public_evidence: retain exactly latest 8 public (x,mediators) pairs as strongest conventional, no extra source, source-world label, hidden equation, oracle, unchosen action, donor or prior finished world parameters.
mechanism.original_grammar: Use exact original AAI-12P controls.GRAMMARS 4 stages, including pair XOR/AND/OR, switch, flip, compensator and inhibitor; no rules added, removed or learned from generator.
mechanism.pairs: Derive adjacent observed transitions from last eight public row records, only if actions_taken changes by exactly +1, goal identical, Hamming(xpre,xpost)<=1 (real do bit set, including no-op). Store at most eight canonical public records including goal, reward and actions_taken for detecting actual interventions; prior conventional has all these fields in its observe calls but only persists (x,m); candidate may NOT retain >8 x,m and may NOT retain private action labels. A paired record may be recognized only if consecutive (pre,post) public action counts and same goal satisfy criteria; no implicit world boundary labels.
mechanism.pointwise_loss: Per hypothesis and output, sum mismatch of predicted m bit vs actual m bit on the latest eight observed public rows, under observed upstream mediators, exactly same as strongest original control.
mechanism.effect_loss: For each qualifying adjacent true do transition, predict mbit BEFORE and AFTER under each observed upstream mediator row, then penalize 1 if predicted XOR change differs from observed XOR change for that mediator. Do not use simulator to evaluate candidate rules.
mechanism.frozen_total_loss: pointwise_mismatches + 2 * intervention_effect_mismatches, tie-break smallest original grammar index, no tunable learning rates, no read of private structural specs.
mechanism.forecast: Use exactly original AAI-12P structural DAG probabilistic composition/smoothing and same controls.choose 0..2 actual action policy; ONLY causal structural-rule selection differs.
mechanism.state: Canonical checkpoint stores latest 8 public rows including only x, mediators, goal, reward and actions_taken (no derived weights/rules cache), verify stable cold restore and bounded memory; infer constraints afresh from public state.
mechanism.same_data_negative: On corrupted action/outcome association challenge pairs, performance must not increase relative to intact. The original conventional remains the negative/control counterfactual without intervention delta weight.
mechanism.fixed_cost: No outer loops or search over thresholds, windows, odds, methods. Fit on 64 original public common records, then 8 challenge records; source-only 192 C/D family unfamiliar episodes and 64 familiar independent cold-restart episodes.

evaluation.controls: All 8 AAI-12P fully fitted eligible conventional methods already qualified identical sources in 43661187182 and 43661424543; strongest original causal_structure_recent8 and causal_structure_recent16 re-executed source-exact against candidate in same source fixtures. No need full eight rerun if first screen fails; if first screen passes rerun all eight source controls.

prespecified_go_no_go.stop: One frozen source-only developmental screen. On any reward/recovery/regret/familiar/contrastive FAIL classify DEV_NO_GO_NO_SCIENCE; do not rerun 8 matched controls, no second algorithm/window/weight search, no first-use. If first screen all PASS only then independently re-run all 8 fully trained original controls and exact full training+fit+challenge+restore+action CPU time per OS and intervention association negative; final DEV is still not SCIENTIFIC PASS.

evaluation.scientific: Not authorized; 192 fixed synthetic cases are not independent scientific 12-world evidence; independent fresh cohorts, seeds, negative controls, cold retention after interference and fully fitted conventional+matched end-to-end resource qualification required before science claim; no original first-use seeds or hidden worlds consumed.

interpretation.comparable_to_prior_AAI11: Different eight-input/four-mediator diverse worlds, so AAI-11 performance scores are NOT numerically comparable.
interpretation.failure: Any source score shortfall must be preserved as no-go; a priori synthetic source protocol was chosen with previous baseline outcomes visible and cannot independently prove science.
